limitations: Digitally rendered acquired waveforms, not independently acquired photographs or scans.
Patient grouping is within PTB; cross-dataset subject linkage and model-training overlap are unknown.
No adjudicated patient interval or morphology annotations; those endpoints remain unavailable.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory at 16 groups; no narrow per-stratum precision claim.
Engineering qualification requires fixed semantic and numeric gates; it is not clinical validation.
All attempted outcomes remain in yield; fidelity is conditional on returned and scored outputs.

cases.visualObservation: Broad row assignment and positive/negative QRS pattern correspond in the overview; fine detail and boundary trimming require source review.
Panel arrangement corresponds, but narrow QRS peaks appear attenuated; a plausible render does not overcome failed numerical fidelity.
Source contains tall/clipped peaks; reconstructed peak heights and small components are altered. Label evidence is unverified.
Twelve-row arrangement and broad QRS/T patterns correspond; no fine-interval adjudication performed.
Clear failure: returned V1 polarity/morphology and beat presentation disagree with the source. Reject visual fidelity despite the plausible render.
Abstention. Perspective-distorted source remains inspectable; no exported signal is treated as reconstructed evidence.
Clear limitations in low-resolution tracing, including retained gap/truncation and altered small/precordial components; source-label evidence is unverified.
Abstention. Rotated source remains inspectable; no reconstructed waveform supplied.
Abstention with prominent source baseline variation; source preserved and available.
Broad 3x4 panel assignment and morphology correspond; fine peak amplitudes require the numerical and source checks.
Blurred narrow peaks are attenuated, with differences in small QRS components; numerical fidelity fails.
Broad twelve-row morphology corresponds, with explicit gaps in V4 reconstruction. Gaps must not be interpreted as continuous observed signal.
Broad 6x2 arrangement corresponds with smoothing of small components; source-label identity remains unverified.
Broad 6x2 morphology corresponds at low resolution; narrow features cannot be validated from the resized overview.
Broad twelve-row morphology corresponds after rotation correction; fine morphology and interval precision are not adjudicated.

limitations: RSS includes shared pages in each process; values are sampled, not an operating-system hard maximum.
Workspace size excludes the separately installed runtime and package.

corrections.reason: Correct per-panel duration, canonical-display truth support and exported canonical uncertainty indices. Saved predictions only; no parameter, threshold, source, truth or extraction changes.

decision: No expanded accuracy or clinical-use claim; retain extraction policy. Fix evaluation metadata/coordinate accounting only. Pilot is now exposed and must not be reused as an untouched final set.
